command: set -euo pipefail; snapshot_count(){ D="$1"; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$D/tracker_database"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$D/tracker_database-wal" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-wal"; }; adb logcat -c; BEFORE=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v3-off-before | tail -n1); PID_BEFORE=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID_BEFORE"; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP;
